response.justification: Bogdan is a versatile, experienced software craftsman with a strong generalist background across web, mobile, and systems programming, but his career shows minimal hands-on Java experience (mostly robotic arms/mobile orchestration years ago) and no evidence of Kotlin, Spring, Quarkus, Hibernate, or IDE/language-tooling internals work. His recent and most substantial experience is TypeScript/Node.js full-stack and DLang systems work, which does not align with the deep JVM/enterprise-Java tooling focus this role requires.
strengths: Deep, broad engineering experience across many languages and paradigms (15+ years)
Demonstrated ability to own complex systems end-to-end (low-latency DLang services, GIS platform)
concerns: No demonstrated Kotlin experience at all
Java experience is minimal, dated, and not enterprise/Spring-focused
No evidence of IDE internals, language tooling, or JVM-specific deep expertise

key_factors.factor: Strong general software craftsmanship and system ownership track record
